How does Moving Walls support Osaka campaigns?

Osaka brings together dense transit networks, major shopping destinations, entertainment districts and international gateways, giving brands multiple opportunities to connect with audiences throughout the city. Moving Walls enables agencies and brands to plan, activate and measure DOOH campaigns across Japan, including Osaka, through its connected media ecosystem and MASTRUM, the programmatic platform developed with JR East Marketing & Communications (jeki).
Osaka's media landscape spans the places where people commute, shop, work, travel and spend their leisure time.
Reach commuters and visitors across Osaka's major railway and subway networks, including high-traffic stations such as Umeda, Namba and Shin-Osaka.
Connect with shoppers along destinations such as Shinsaibashi-suji, where retail footfall brings together local consumers and international visitors.
Build visibility in high-energy areas such as Namba and Dotonbori, where large-format digital media sits within one of Osaka's most recognisable entertainment districts.
Engage domestic and international travellers across Kansai International Airport and Itami Airport as they enter and move through the region.
Osaka offers advertisers a combination of scale, movement and audience diversity that makes it relevant for campaigns looking beyond individual media locations.
The wider Keihanshin metropolitan area connects a population of more than 19 million people, creating a substantial audience base across Osaka and its surrounding cities.
Millions of passenger journeys across Osaka's transit network create repeated opportunities for brands to build visibility throughout the day.
Digital OOH continues to expand in Japan, giving advertisers more opportunities to use dynamic, flexible and data-informed outdoor media.
